impact: French cloud provider OVHcloud on Monday disclosed that one of its GitHub repositories was compromised, and that threat actors replaced existing assets in the company's open source command-line interface (CLI) tool with malicious binaries. "The hacker used the GitHub account of one of the developers and added a binary whose job is to retrieve secrets from the disk," Klaba wrote in an X post. For a brief period, the threat actors swapped out the legitimate releases with malicious versions of the tool.
